# cool-retro-term

|> Default Amber|C:\ IBM DOS|$ Default Green|
|---|---|---|
||||

## Description
cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator which mimics the look and feel of the old cathode tube screens.
It has been designed to be eye-candy, customizable, and reasonably lightweight.

It uses the QML port of qtermwidget (Konsole): https://github.com/Swordfish90/qmltermwidget.

This terminal emulator works under Linux and macOS and requires Qt6.

Settings such as colors, fonts, and effects can be accessed via context menu.

## Screenshots




## Install

If you want to get a hold of the latest version, just go to the Releases page and grab the latest AppImage (Linux) or dmg (macOS).

Alternatively, most distributions such as Ubuntu, Fedora or Arch already package cool-retro-term in their official repositories.

## Building

Check out the wiki and follow the instructions on how to build it on [Linux](https://github.com/Swordfish90/cool-retro-term/wiki/Build-Instructions-(Linux)) and [macOS](https://github.com/Swordfish90/cool-retro-term/wiki/Build-Instructions-(macOS)).

aiSummary.oneLiner: A highly customizable terminal emulator that mimics the visual style of old cathode tube screens.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: cool-retro-term is an eye-catching terminal emulator designed to replicate the nostalgic look and feel of vintage cathode tube (CRT) monitors. It offers extensive customization options, allowing users to tweak colors, fonts, and visual effects like screen curvature and phosphor glow directly through a context menu. The application is built using the QML port of qtermwidget (Konsole) and requires Qt6 to run. Despite its heavy visual styling, it remains reasonably lightweight and functions as a fully capable command-line interface. It is packaged for easy installation across Linux and macOS systems.
keyFeatures: CRT emulation: Replicates the visual artifacts and phosphor glow of vintage cathode tube displays accurately.
Customizable aesthetics: Allows extensive configuration of colors, fonts, and screen effects via a context menu.
Cross-platform support: Runs seamlessly on both Linux and macOS operating systems.
Qt6 architecture: Built using modern Qt6 and the QML port of qtermwidget for reliable terminal performance.
Pre-packaged binaries: Offers AppImage for Linux and dmg files for macOS for immediate installation.
Nostalgic profiles: Includes default color profiles like amber and green IBM DOS themes out of the box.
